summary: Candidate represents a distinct capability: AgentOps SDK initialization with deferred session startup and function-level trace decoration. It differs semantically from peer candidates (which cover automatic session initialization, broad observability setup, and generic decorator patterns) and existing skills (which address OpenTelemetry, Spring Boot migration, and Flink environments). The specific combination of auto_start_session=False with @trace decorator instrumentation is a novel, supported workflow not covered by existing registry entries.
